derived.step1: 'To round to the nearest ' + scope.placeName + ', look at the digit in the ' + scope.decidingPlace + ' place, which is ' + scope.decidingDigit + '.'
derived.step2: scope.decidingDigit >= 5 ? 'Since ' + scope.decidingDigit + ' >= 5, round up and replace remaining digits with zeros to keep the value of the original number.' : 'Since ' + scope.decidingDigit + ' < 5, replace remaining digits with zeros to keep the value of the original number.'

structures.questionTemplate: Round the number $$${scope.num}$$ to the nearest ${scope.placeName}.

derived.step1: 'To round to 1 decimal place, look at the digit in the 2nd decimal place, which is ' + scope.c + '.'
derived.step2: scope.c >= 5 ? 'Since ' + scope.c + ' >= 5, round ' + scope.b + ' up to ' + (scope.b + 1) + '.' : 'Since ' + scope.c + ' < 5, keep ' + scope.b + ' unchanged.'

derived.ans: scope.d >= 5 ? scope.a + '.' + scope.b + (scope.c + 1) : scope.a + '.' + scope.b + scope.c
derived.step1: 'To round to 2 decimal places, look at the digit in the 3rd decimal place, which is ' + scope.d + '.'
derived.step2: scope.d >= 5 ? 'Since ' + scope.d + ' >= 5, round ' + scope.c + ' up to ' + (scope.c + 1) + '.' : 'Since ' + scope.d + ' < 5, keep ' + scope.c + ' unchanged.'

derived.step1: 'The first two significant figures are ' + scope.d1 + scope.d2 + '. Look at the 3rd digit, which is ' + scope.d3 + '.'
derived.step2: scope.d3 >= 5 ? 'Since ' + scope.d3 + ' >= 5, round ' + scope.d2 + ' up to ' + (scope.d2 + 1) + ' and replace remaining digits with zeros to keep the value of the original number.' : 'Since ' + scope.d3 + ' < 5, replace remaining digits with zeros to keep the value of the original number.'

derived.ans: scope.d3 >= 5 ? '0.' + scope.zerosStr + scope.d1 + (scope.d2 + 1) : '0.' + scope.zerosStr + scope.d1 + scope.d2
derived.step1: 'The first non-zero digit is ' + scope.d1 + '. The first 2 significant figures are ' + scope.d1 + scope.d2 + '.'
derived.step2: scope.d3 >= 5 ? 'Since the next digit is ' + scope.d3 + ' (>= 5), round ' + scope.d2 + ' up to ' + (scope.d2 + 1) + '.' : 'Since the next digit is ' + scope.d3 + ' (< 5), keep ' + scope.d2 + ' unchanged.'

derived.step1: 'Identify the first 4 significant figures of ' + scope.val + ', which are ' + scope.a + scope.b + '59.'
derived.step2: 'Look at the 5th digit, which is 9. Since 9 >= 5, round up. Rounding 9 up causes a carry-over, giving ' + scope.ans + '. Replace remaining positions with zeros to keep the value of the original number.'
